units.rawText: Professor, here's the data I organized while you were still in Rossum. I hope this can help you recover your memory.

units.rawText: Thank you, Turing. I appreciate your work.

units.rawText: But some of the data involves interactions between you and me in the past, Professor… and that part of the data originally belonged to Hannah. Even though she's granted me access, I believe I should inform her before sharing it with you.

units.rawText: Yes... Those memories feel both familiar and strange at the same time. When I first saw them, I felt happiness, but also fear and a sense of being lost...
